entities.name: legal ramifications
entities.description: The potential legal consequences and implications arising from agreements, documents, or actions related to city policies, school expansions, and covenant enforcement.

entities.name: school expansion
entities.description: The process and considerations involved in increasing the capacity or size of schools within the city, including approval processes and compliance with regulations.

entities.name: student limitations
entities.description: Restrictions or caps on the number of students that can attend a school, often documented through annual affidavits and subject to legal agreements.

entities.name: enforcement of covenant
entities.description: The legal actions and procedures used to ensure compliance with covenants or agreements, including enforcement measures when violations occur.

entities.name: school footprint
entities.description: The physical area occupied by a school, including buildings and surrounding land, often considered in planning and expansion projects.
